surfaceMeaning: No resolved global surface imagery; the standard grid marks unmapped terrain.
unresolved: Oblate versus triaxial shape and 8.8394 h versus 17.6788 h spin interpretations remain model-dependent.
The 572.5 MB supplementary archive contains lightcurves/model profiles, not a resolved surface texture; downloading it is unnecessary for the published numeric fit.
name: Quaoar
credit: Margoti et al. (2026), accepted ApJ; 36 stellar-occultation campaigns
shapeMeaning: Published 3D oblate fit: equatorial semiaxes 566.1 km and polar semiaxis 511.2 km. The fit assumes the body pole aligns with the rings. A competing triaxial interpretation is unresolved.
orientationMeaning: Pole RA 259.7°, DEC 53.4° inherits the measured ring-plane prior; arbitrary meridian. The 8.8394 h and 17.6788 h period interpretations remain model-dependent and no sidereal spin is installed.
introduction: This large Kuiper-belt object has two known rings. Its oblate shape is fitted to stellar occultations with the ring plane as a pole constraint; surface detail is unresolved.
